headings.usage: Use tight letter spacing (tracking-tight) for all headings. Never center-align. Keep it punchy and left-aligned.

body.usage: Technical body font, ideal for clear legibility on numbers (quotes/invoices) in harsh outdoor environments.

spacing_and_layout.system: Generous Spacing (Tailwind Scale). Padding defaults to p-4 or p-6 for cards. Use p-8 for major sections.
spacing_and_layout.grid_strategy: Control Room Grid (Dense, Data Correlation) for Dashboard KPIs. Use grid-cols-2 for mobile screens, ensuring elements stretch fully.
spacing_and_layout.mobile_specific: Bottom Tab Navigation is MANDATORY. Use glassmorphism (`backdrop-blur-xl bg-white/90 border-t border-zinc-200`) to maintain context while scrolling. Tap targets minimum 48x48px.

surfaces_and_components.cards: Neumorphism (The 'Tactile' Variant) adapted for high-visibility. Flat white background, sharp 1px border (`border-zinc-200`), heavy ambient shadow (`shadow-md`).
surfaces_and_components.buttons: Large, chunky, solid background. Primary buttons use Copper/Orange (#E15C32) with dark inner shadow for physical press feel. High contrast.
surfaces_and_components.badges: Solid background colors with white text for status tracking (Brouillon/Envoyé/Accepté). Avoid low-contrast pastel backgrounds. For example, solid Blue for 'Envoyé', solid Green for 'Accepté', Outline/Zinc for 'Brouillon'.
surfaces_and_components.forms: Use customized Shadcn components. Input fields must have `bg-white`, solid `border-zinc-300`, and focus ring of `ring-primary/20`. Large tap areas.

images_and_media.strategy: Use images for onboarding, empty states, and marketing material. Avoid generic graphics; prefer industrial, tactile textures.

urls.description: Copper pipes forming a cross shape on blue background. Use with heavy gradient overlay (`bg-zinc-900/80`) as background for Login or Onboarding step 1.
Plumber fixing water heater. Good for empty states in 'Clients' or 'Catalogue'.
Close-up of a plumber's hands installing pipes. Perfect for 'Create your first quote' empty state visual.

instructions_to_main_agent.general: Build this as a highly mobile-optimized React application representing the React Native Expo app (SaaS CRM). Focus on responsive design but explicitly design for a mobile/tablet portrait viewport as the primary consumption method. The entire layout should feel like a native app (no generic website headers).
instructions_to_main_agent.navigation: Implement bottom tab bar (Accueil, Devis, Clients, Catalogue, Factures) using fixed positioning at the bottom (`fixed bottom-0 w-full z-50`).
instructions_to_main_agent.language: All UI text MUST be in French.
instructions_to_main_agent.icons: Use lucide-react. Standardize stroke-width to 2 or 2.5 for a slightly bolder, utilitarian feel.

specific_features.quote_creation: Must have a prominent 'Voice Input' style floating action button or primary CTA (Microphone icon) for AI generation.
specific_features.quote_editor: Use ledger-style tables (tight grid layout with visible borders) for line items, showing Description, Qté, Unité, PU HT, TVA.
specific_features.dashboard: Use Bento grid (Control Room pattern) for KPIs like 'Devis acceptés', 'CA du mois', 'En attente'. Use thick borders and strong typography.
specific_features.client_detail: Show highly visible quick actions (Appeler, Email, Nouveau Devis) at the top of the client profile.
